inputs.text: a single stained-glass window panel filling the entire image, every element built from cut pieces of colored cathedral glass joined by thick black lead came lines with solder joints, radiant light glowing through translucent glass: the king of spades with short silver-grey hair and black spade crown walking beside the queen of diamonds with red-orange hair and diamond tiara along a garden path, his hair crown and black-and-silver armor all formed from shards of grey silver and black glass with ONLY black spade shapes set as dark glass inlays across his chest shoulders and skirt, her hair tiara and white gown all formed from shards of amber white and ruby glass with ONLY red diamond shapes set as glass inlays across her bodice and skirt, no skin no fabric no metal only glass, faces simplified to flat glass pieces with minimal lead-line features, around them topiary hedges roses sunset clouds and stone path all formed from green pink gold and cream glass shards with visible lead outlines, arched border of dark lead, jewel-tone glow, subtle bubbles streaks and hammered texture inside the glass. glyphs that must appear: spade glass ONLY on him, diamond glass ONLY on her, no letters or text anywhere
